question.prompt: The polynomial \(x^3 - 2004x^2 + mx + n\) has integer coefficients and three distinct positive zeros. Exactly one of these is an integer, and it is the sum of the other two. How many values of \(n\) are possible?

solutions.explanation:
The condition that one root equals the sum of the other two makes the total root sum twice that integer root. Let the integer root be \(r\), and let the other roots be \(u,v\). Expanding \((x-r)(x-u)(x-v)\) shows that the coefficient of \(x^2\) is \(-(r+u+v)\). Therefore
\[
2r=r+u+v=2004,
\]
so \(r=1002\) and \(u+v=1002\).

Set \(q=uv\). The polynomial factors as
\[
(x-1002)(x^2-1002x+q).
\]
Expanding and comparing coefficients gives
\[
m=1002^2+q,\qquad n=-1002q.
\]
Since \(m\) is an integer, \(q\) is an integer. Also, different values of \(q\) give different values of \(n\), so it suffices to count the possible \(q\).

The quadratic has two distinct real roots exactly when
\[
1002^2-4q>0.
\]
For real roots with sum \(1002>0\), a positive product makes both roots positive. Thus distinct positivity is equivalent to
\[
0<q<501^2=251001.
\]
There are \(251000\) integer candidates, namely \(1\) through \(251000\). Both positive roots are less than their sum \(1002\), so neither equals the third root.

We must now remove the cases in which either quadratic root is an integer. If one is an integer, the other is also an integer because their sum is \(1002\). Every such unordered pair can be written uniquely as
\[
\{k,1002-k\},\qquad k=1,2,\ldots,500,
\]
where \(k\) is the smaller root. The value \(k=501\) would give equal roots and is already outside the allowed range.

These \(500\) pairs give \(500\) different products. Indeed, if \(q_k=k(1002-k)\), then
\[
q_{k+1}-q_k=1001-2k>0
\qquad(1\leq k\leq499).
\]
Every remaining integer \(q\) produces an integer-coefficient polynomial with exactly the required three distinct positive roots and exactly one integer root. Hence the number of possible values of \(n\) is
\[
251000-500=\boxed{250500},
\]
choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
solutions.title: Fix the integer root and count products
